text: 17-year-old female. The patient presents with a 5-day history of severe abdominal pain and cramping, accompanied by nausea and vomiting. speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing those details; the dysuria and dyspareunia alongside right-sided pain are concerning. Given your age, sexual history, and symptoms, could you tell me if you have any vaginal discharge or fever? Also, have you noticed any unusual vaginal bleeding?

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pyelonephritis secondary to ascending UTI. Given the severity of symptoms including vomiting and dysuria in a sexually active female, immediate urine culture and renal ultrasound are required to rule out obstruction or abscess.
